bugs.summary: #viewer is position:fixed; inset:0; width:0; flex:0 0 0. The docked width override applies only when preview-docked and data-fullscreen is not 1. Fullscreen and the narrow overlay both compute to a 0px-wide box, so the picture never fills the window.

canDockViewer allows a dock at gridMin+previewMin+People (864px here) and ignores the two 6px splitters. clampPreviewWidth then forces the preview to at least 320 even when the leftover max is below 320, so the grid stage was 268px.
